reviews.x: The Primal Elements loaf Soap in Ariel is one of the best Glycerin Soaps that we have found.  The deal on Amazon was great for the 5 pound loaf.  The Ariel Glycerin Soap is by far the best in the Primal Elements line for men.  The fragrance is fabulous and is not too over powering.  I would recommend that you also get a soap dish with a grated or open bottom so the soap will not disolve while not in use.  We will continue to order this soap forever!!!

We love this soap and have been using it for many years. Usually we buy our yearly loaf from the Primal site but noticed it on Amazon for a lower price. It has a wonderful scent and my Grandchildren think it is the prettiest one when they use my tub. They tend to fight over it so we usually make two bars at a time so they each can use one.

reviews.t: I Won't Use Any Other Soap!!!
reviews.x: I have been using Primal Elements for years. I have very sensitive skin and other soaps feel like my skin is shrinking as I dry off. Putting lotion on after a bath or shower makes me feel dirty again. I used Dove soap for most of my life, but when I purchased a bar of Primal Elements, I gave all my Dove to a friend. The smell of Ariel is just delicious!! It reminds me of the good old days when I burned insence all the time, and when I came home and opened the door I would be welcomed by that sce

I have used Ariel soap since I was getting it from Earth to Olde City soap shop in Gatlinburg.  This loaf is large enough I don't have to worry about running out or being stingy with when I use it.  The soap is moisturizing and the scent is intoxicating.  I love this soap!!  I was so glad to know you can now get lotion, perfume, and shampoo.  Please start making conditioner, as other conditioners will just wash the scent of Ariel from your hair if you use them!

I love Primal Elelements soaps.  Facets of the Sea is my all time favorite.  A clean smell that's not so overbearing and clean smell. Makes my dry skin feel so much better. I will never use another brand.  Just take it out of the soap dish when you finish and it will last longer than it staying in the shower area.  Well worth the money. 3 bars usually last me 6 months.
The shape of the bar was not ideal.. It was to big to be as thin as it was.  It broke in two fairly quickly.  The lather wasn't that great.  All in all I didn't care for it and will not reorder.
A light, fresh scent and doesn't dry out my skin.
luv this my favorite , I buy again and again

reviews.t: Wonderful scent, reminiscent of Wild Musk Oil
reviews.x: We purchase a loaf of the Ariel scented soap about every 2 years.  Soaps last forever if allowed to dry out in a soap dish (as opposed to sitting in water).  The scent of the bar is a strong musk and sandalwood.  On skin though, it is faintly scented and you can only smell it for a few minutes.  Truly wish there was a perfume that matched this, I would wear it daily (sandalwood geek).

reviews.t: Long Time Favorite Here. PERFECTION, as always
reviews.x: Primal Elements Wrapped Bar Soap, Ariel, 6.8-Ounce  by Primal Elements Long Time Favorite Here. PERFECTION, as always..  and another SMOOTHY!!!  I do not care for the exfoliant soaps, so this one has been on my list for a while, and this vendor is new to me via AMAZON, but the product is.. as always..  Par Excellence!!  Highly recommend to you soap connoisseurs..!!!!  Y E S !!

reviews.x: This was my first time using this scent and I love this one to so I be getting this one again I live in Texas and I don't order in spring or summer due to high heat and be scare that scent may not be strong enough so I do it in fall and it be my favorites one and the scent is strong  and rock in gifts does a wonderful job in sending to me a very great service.

This is my favorite soap and I've used it for years. I think it must be a favorite of many people because it can be hard to find locally. It's also pricey, sold by the slice. When I found this available by the block last year, I immediately ordered it. The block lasts about a year for me, so makes it economical. It's a great product, too.

I have purchased Primal Elements Ariel soap ever since one of my Yoga instructors told me it is the only soap she uses. I asked her why she always smelled so nice. I love the fragrance. Was afraid it would be "too patchouli" but it isn't. I will continue to buy it until they stop making it.

love this soap. Found it about 20 years back while visiting San Diego & was so excited to see it on Amazon!! It is the same great scent & quality as the last bar!!  ( had a friend that lived there get me more after I returned home & its been about 5 years since I used the last of my stash)

reviews.t: The smell is intoxicating and uniquely light.
reviews.x: Love this soap! My aunt introduced me to it and it’s just amazing. Great lather, I feel super clean after and the smell is intoxicating! Good for a man or a woman. My skin is soft after and the scent lasts. I’m a teacher and my kids always comment on the scent because it’s so calming.

I originally came across this soap in ta boutique in the Sacramento airport while waiting for a flight back to San Diego. I was thrilled I found it online. It's a great soap. The delivery was fast and efficient and I will order this product many more times in the future.

Ugh, I thought this soap was so unique and attractive until I actually used it.  It isn't at all moisturizing and leaves a weird film on your skin after use.  This is strictly a novelty item.  I do not recommend it even for that though....put your money elsewhere!

This is my all time favorite soap because it has a rich sensual fragrance.  Could be used for a male or female. This is a fantastic deal for a loaf of This soap.  If you buy it from another site, you are looking at $70.
I love Primal Elements soap, especially the scent Ariel!  It rinses easily and leaves me feeling clean and tingly.  I've given it away as gifts to numerous people.  I highly recommend it!

reviews.t: my Dad and my husband LOVE this soap
reviews.x: I would disappoint my Dad and my husband if I did not get this soap every Christmas for them as stocking stuffers.  it smells fabulous.  If you are a sandalwood fan, it's a must have!
I used to find this soap in special shops but since Covid,  I have not been shopping.  Very glad to find it on Amazon.  It is my favorite soap scent.
Nice soap and it smells really good.  I would recommend purchase if you get a good price.  This is a great gift for someone who likes sandalwood.
This was bought for someone who has Sensitive Skin and we are on our 3rd Bar,it works perfect for them!
I use this to wash my face.  It is mild and works very well.  Love it!  Would recommend to others.
I really love the fragrance of ariel, It's fresh and smells lovely in the bath..

claims.text: Reviewers overwhelmingly praise the soap's fragrance, describing it as pleasant, strong yet not overpowering, and long-lasting.
Many customers report the soap is gentle and moisturizing, helping with dry or sensitive skin.
Several reviewers are long-time repeat buyers who have used the soap for years and intend to keep purchasing it.
Customers appreciate the large loaf/block size and value, noting it lasts a long time and is cheaper than buying by the slice.
One reviewer was disappointed, finding the bar shape awkward, prone to breaking, and the lather weak.
